title: anthemis tinctoria subsp. triumfetti
intro: Anthemis tinctoria subsp. triumfetti, commonly known as Chamois, is a subspecies of the yellow chamomile plant. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used in traditional herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Anthemis tinctoria subsp. triumfetti include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-allergic activities.
